summary: 'Estragon Vision', a one-screen web app by Dinamo with Stink Studios and RITA (render-in-the-air): after a typewriter intro ('Hi, I'm Estragon!' → 'What's new?'), the visitor types up to 22 characters, picks a style and colour, and presses Generate; the text then appears in a wall of rendered retro scenes (Tamagotchi, highway billboard, cassette, MacPaint, typewriter, skull). Story, glyph grid and credits sit in collapsible 'Specifications' and 'About' panels.

instances.look: A blank white screen where a line is typed and deleted letter by letter in the centre: 'Hi, I'm Estragon!' then 'What's new?' (the crop is captured before typing starts)
instances.ux: Plays automatically (~5s), then the panel shrinks to the left half and the app appears
instances.learn: Introduce a display face with a typed greeting in its own letters: the first words are the font speaking

reconstruction.layout: Full viewport white; one centred line ~60px tall; afterwards the white area becomes the top-left panel (720×450) of the app
reconstruction.behaviour: Typewriter effect: characters added ~80ms apart, held, deleted, next phrase typed; ends on the input placeholder 'What's new?'

instances.variantDefinition: A short text field (with style and colour pickers) whose input is rendered, often server-side as video or 3D, into a wall of realistic scenes and objects (billboards, gadgets, screens, signage), so the visitor sees their own words in use rather than in a plain sample line
instances.look: Split screen: on the left a white panel with the editable line 'What's new?' over three grey pill buttons (Aa · Generate · colour), above a black-gradient panel; on the right a grey-gradient wall where tilted, irregular frames fly in and settle into six looping clips that each show the same words: a Tamagotchi screen, a 'NEXT EXIT' highway billboard, a cassette label, a MacPaint window, a typewriter page and a chrome skull
instances.ux: Type up to 22 characters, cycle the style (Aa: stylistic sets Wildstyle / Arrow / Bubble) and colour, press Generate; the frames re-render with your text; a round handle on the split lets you resize the panels
instances.learn: Render the visitor's own words into many familiar objects at once: a 22-character input becomes a whole in-use campaign

reconstruction.layout: 1440×900 app, no scroll: left column 648px (white form panel 0–450px, dark specifications panel below); right 792px wall of six tilted quadrilateral frames in a 2×3 grid (~330×230px each, polygon clip-paths); round resize handle (24px, #c1c1c1) on the divider at y≈450
reconstruction.typography: Input ~64px Estragon Regular centred; buttons ~13px Favorit in grey pills (~60–140×24px); 'ABOUT' / 'SPECIFICATIONS' 12px underlined caps Favorit
reconstruction.behaviour: On load, empty frames fly in (spin, scale) and fill with video clips; Generate (disabled until text changes) sends the text to the RITA renderer and swaps in personalised clips; style button cycles stylistic sets; colour button cycles text colour
reconstruction.content: Default prompt 'What's new?'; scenes chosen for retro tech nostalgia
reconstruction.assets: Six pre-rendered/personalised video scenes (gadgets, signage, software), tilted frame masks
reconstruction.html: input.rita-text-input[maxlength=22][name=text] + Form buttons style-button / generate-button[type=submit] / color-button; button.resizable-track on the split

instances.look: Collapsed 'SPECIFICATIONS' panel shows 'Estragon is a new typeface from Dinamo.' and three white sample lines on black ('Shiny ⁂ Dragon Scales / Ă Broadsword ✕ Shield / [Atyn:] Frog Princess!'); expanded (HTML only) it holds a grid of ~105 characters: A–Z, a–z, figures, punctuation, brackets, currency, arrows, ligatures
instances.ux: Click 'SPECIFICATIONS' to open the panel; each cell swaps to its alternate on hover (stylistic sets Wildstyle, Arrow, Bubble)
instances.learn: Give every grid cell a hover twin showing its stylistic alternate, so the set and its variations live in one grid

reconstruction.layout: Panel in the left column below the form (y≈450–900 collapsed, slides up when opened); grid of square cells ~6–8 per row inside the 648px column
reconstruction.typography: Sample lines ~40px Estragon Regular white, centred; grid glyphs ~40px; caption 'Characters including variable stylistic sets: Wildstyle, Arrow, Bubble.' ~13px Favorit
reconstruction.behaviour: Hover a cell → .character-hover layer shows the alternate glyph
reconstruction.content: Full basic set plus dingbats (⁒, ⬤), arrows and fi/fl ligatures

instances.look: Inside the Specifications panel (HTML only): one paragraph on the source, a few characters from 'Harrild and Sons' New and Abridged Specimens' (c. 1890) found via the Type Founders Archive, plus an image of the original specimen credited to Nick Sherman / Letterform Archive
instances.ux: Hidden until the panel is opened; links to Dinamo Dark Room
